fact: The Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare, with the World Bank and UNICEF, launched the Integrated Social Protection Management Information System, piloted in Cyclone Idai districts with the Food Deficit Mitigation Strategy Programme.
system: Integrated Social Protection Management Information System (ISPMIS)

fact: Gemnation reports that the Harmonised Social Cash Transfer programme pays beneficiaries by electronic transfer (EcoCash), citing the Auditor-General's note that the payment method has changed from cash.

The World Bank's February 2026 project document says Zimbabwe has the foundations of a social registry system, ZISO, formerly the Integrated Social Protection Management Information System, and that household enumeration and hosting are still needed to operationalise it.
